data_provenance: REAL public LRGASP WTC11 (ENCODE): PacBio cDNA ENCSR507JOF (3 reps), ONT cDNA ENCSR539ZXJ (rep 1), Illumina ENCSR673UKZ (rep 1) -> minimap2 / STAR 2-pass, IsoQuant 3.13, SQANTI3 6.0.1 vs GENCODE v49; truth = LRGASP Supplementary Data 15 (amplicon-sequencing validation): sheet wtc11-support (89 WTC11 consolidated-model targets, chains from WTC11_consolidated.bed.gz) and sheet gencode-support (79 GENCODE-reviewed known/novel/rejected models, chains from LRGASP_manual_annotation.human.all.bed.gz + human_GENCODE_tmerge_transcripts.bed.gz; 76 resolvable). No private data.
notes: Per target set, platform and short-read setting: of the targets whose intron chain our IsoQuant run reported exactly, the PanIsoGuard class distribution for supported / likely / unsupported targets, plus how many experimentally supported isoforms carry SQANTI3's RTS_stage sign. Mostly positives (wtc11: 79 supported / 7 unsupported; gencode: 48 supported / 23 unsupported), so a recall-side check first; the negatives the caller did reconstruct are the only real-data precision evidence. [cross_library] --validation-bam with the other platform's library (same WTC11 cells): per-isoform whole-chain counts in the caller's own BAM vs the independent one, for the validated targets, the genome-wide chain lifts (split by the RT-switch sign) and expressed FSM as the baseline.
